component.name: Pires Forge
component.summary: A desktop application for laser cutting and engraving

description.p: Pires Forge is a modern, cross-platform 2D CAD, G-code sender and control software for GRBL, Marlin, Ruida, and Smoothieware-based laser cutters and engravers. It provides a clean native interface for Linux, macOS, and Windows, offering a full suite of tools for both hobbyists and professionals.

Features include a parametric 2D sketch editor, comprehensive canvas tools, multi-layer operations, machine control with work-coordinate systems and no-go zones, a material library with auto-matching presets, 2.5D cutting with multi-pass, true 4th axis rotary support, animated 3D toolpath simulation, post- processors, addon extensibility, and support for a broad range of file formats.

Pires Forge is an independent fork of the Rayforge project. The user-visible identity, update channel, security policy, and release cadence are maintained by Yuri Schmaltz. The Python module path, addon API, and project structure are kept compatible with the original Rayforge codebase.

screenshot.caption: The main window of Pires Forge.

description.p: First stable release of Pires Forge.

This is a rebrand and maintenance fork of the Rayforge project. The user-visible identity (display name, AppStream ID, .desktop, .metainfo, Debian package name) is now Pires Forge. The Python module path, addon API, and project structure are kept identical to upstream for compatibility.
Included changes versus the upstream snapshot:

ul.li: All GitHub URLs point to yuri-schmaltz/pires-forge; update check now defaults to off
defusedxml runtime dependency for untrusted XML parsing (LightBurn, SVG)
Security hardening: bandit gates, supply-chain checks, reproducible builds
Internationalization fix: .mo files are now bundled in all distribution packages (deb, dmg, exe)
Cross-platform packaging: .deb for Ubuntu 24.04, .dmg for macOS (universal), .exe for Windows (NSIS)
Translation completeness: English, Portuguese, Spanish, German, French, Ukrainian, Chinese
